title: Active and Visited States knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Active and Visited States?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with active and visited states?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.

questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Active-state styling, Visited links, Link-state differences, Interactive feedback patterns.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying active and visited states?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.

questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
